summary: Today header date wraps one word per line at launch and reflows 300-400 ms later, overlapping the Refreshing bar (DashboardView header status row animates inside the entrance)
Dashboard launch entrance ignores Reduce Motion: ring spring and content slide/scale still run (DashboardView showLoadedStateIfNeeded has no reduceMotion check)
Recalibration card inserts above the ring about 0.3 s after the ring finishes, pushing the layout down 40 pt
Onboarding page change crossfade stacks two pages of readable text for 3-4 frames
Calories detail push shows ghosted placeholders and doubled Recent Days rows for about 15 frames
Idle screens keep rendering at 30 fps (CTA glow, sheet hero float) behind static content
